## Piercing and marking language

> The resistance gave with a small pop. Pain arrived first as a white point,
> then as radiating heat; her breath broke, the surrounding flesh tightened,
> and a bead of blood tracked warm across her skin. The metallic click afterward
> made the change feel more final than the pain itself.

Track anticipation, the instant of change, radiating sensation, involuntary
muscle response, sound, visible evidence, and the adult character's emotional
interpretation. Use words such as pressure, resistance, pop, sting, white heat,
pulse, copper scent, bead, smear, tremor, click, mark, and aftermath.
